header.headline: Backend Software Engineer | Python, Django, Kafka, AWS

summary: Backend Software Engineer with {YEARS} years building REST APIs, event pipelines and data jobs in **Python and Java**. Cut p95 API latency from **480 ms to 190 ms** with Redis caching and PostgreSQL tuning, and designed **Kafka** pipelines processing **40k messages per minute**. Comfortable with **AWS, Docker and Terraform**, CI/CD, on-call duty and automated testing.

skills.label: Backend:
skills.text: Django, Flask, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Microservices, Celery

skills.label: Data and messaging:
skills.text: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Apache Kafka, Airflow

skills.label: Cloud and DevOps:
skills.text: AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, ECS, Lambda), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitHub Actions

skills.label: Testing:
skills.text: pytest, JUnit, unit and integration testing

bullets: Built REST APIs in **Python (Django)** serving **1.2M requests per day** for an inventory forecasting platform
Cut p95 API latency from **480 ms to 190 ms** by adding **Redis caching** and optimising **PostgreSQL** queries
Designed **Kafka**-based event pipelines that process **40k messages per minute** with at-least-once delivery
Set up **CI/CD** with GitHub Actions and Docker, reducing release time from 2 hours to 25 minutes
Mentored 2 junior engineers and led weekly code reviews for a team of 6
Developed Java Spring Boot microservices for order management, handling 15k orders per day
Wrote **pytest** and JUnit suites that raised test coverage from 55% to 82%
Automated nightly data reconciliation jobs in **Python**, saving about 10 hours of manual work each week
Handled **on-call** rotations and resolved production incidents with a median time to restore of 35 minutes
Implemented REST endpoints and database schemas for a customer support portal using Flask and MySQL
Fixed 120+ defects and shipped 8 feature releases over two years
Forecasts demand for 5,000 SKUs with a **Python** service and a nightly Airflow job
Deployed on **AWS** (ECS, RDS, S3) with **Terraform** and GitHub Actions
